Smart-seq VISp (Tasic 2018), Vip | DC3 x DC4 | n 1690 | k 20 | k/n 1.18% | bandwidth 2.00 old bin widths (DC3 4.11e-04, DC4 2.64e-04) | types set aside: none (details: types, walls, notes)This is a projection, not the landscape: each surface value averages cells of different basins that land near that point in 2-D, so walls in 50-D can vanish or smear, and kernel smoothing makes basins look shallower and walls lower than the per-cell U. Read heights from the tree. Surface = Gaussian kernel regression (Nadaraya-Watson) of per-cell U (raw D above the lowest cell) on an 80 x 80 grid over the 1st-99th percentile box; bandwidth = the largest grid value whose leave-one-out error is within 3% of the minimum (optimum 1.25, +2.6% LOO error). Colour = height (RdYlBu_r, this surface's min-max).
Cells (all 1690) on the floor below the surface. Dotted drop lines (Basin colouring; one legend click hides them): from the surface down to the floor at each basin's lowest cell (smallest per-cell U), in the basin colour. Buttons: Basin = L3s basins at k (tree colours; a 10x basin shares a Smart-seq colour only when the two are matched, mutual best cosine >= 0.7; other basins have colours used nowhere else); t-type = native Tasic t-type, Tasic AIT29 colours. Types set aside at stage 1 are not in the landscape and are not drawn. DCs: eigenvalue-scaled diffusion components of the saved embedding, signs as the static poster page.
Bundle results/261006/v2_regression/r1_amended/L_V_Vip. Script scripts/poster_2610_html_261117.py (branch poster-261013).
Supertype (mapped) button: the same 1690 Smart-seq cells at the same positions, coloured by their mapped 10x label, the WMB supertype from MapMyCells hierarchical mapping to the whole-brain taxonomy (10x whole mouse brain, CCN20230722; cell_type_mapper 1.6.0), with the atlas colours of the Supertype button of the 10x v2 pages. Because the mapping is to the whole-brain taxonomy, cells can map outside their subclass (here 50 of 1690 cells do). This is a different method from the Round T mapping (nearest t-type centroid) behind the t-type button of the 10x pages. Cells with supertype bootstrapping probability < 0.80 are one light grey group, 'low confidence' (240 cells), listed last; supertypes with < 20 confident cells are pooled as 'other (< 20)' (2 cells). Order = the 10x v2 page order. Not on the 10x v2 Vip page: 0200 Lamp5 Gaba_2, 26 cells, 0187 Sncg Gaba_3, 21 cells (the cells map outside the subclass). Script scripts/poster_2610_html_t3b_261117.py.
